paper.title: Reducing Belief Deviation in Reinforcement Learning for Active Reasoning of LLM Agents
paper.affiliation: Department of Computer Science and Engineering, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
paper.summary: Active reasoning requires large language model (LLM) agents to interact with external sources and strategically gather information to solve problems in multiple turns. Central to this process is belief tracking: maintaining an accurate representation of the underlying state and uncertainty in understanding and solving the problem.
